'''Gizka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] with the [[Dar'manda]].<ref name="BTS-World">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190904|text=Behind The Scenes Of World Design}}</ref> Composed of other former Mandalorians on [[Mek-Sha]], the Dar'manda were a group of gunrunners and mercenaries active during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Codex" />

She was the youngest member of the Dar'manda. Due to this, Gizka's armor was the most scraped together in the group.<ref name="BTS-World" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gizka first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' which was the seventh Digital Expansion to [[Star Wars: The Old Republic|''SWTOR'']].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> The development of her design was oversaw by Dave Shramek.<ref name="BTS-World" />
